description_en: Associates an advanced office network with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 将高级办公网络与云企业网实例绑定
kebab_example: aliyun ecd attach-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachCen

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account to which the CEN instance belongs.

If the specified CenId belongs to the current Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to configure this parameter.

If the specified CenId belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account, specify the Alibaba Cloud account ID of that account
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。

如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If the specified CenId belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html to obtain the verification code first
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_id
